parallelize_model: parallelize a PyTorch model using FSDP sharding, activation checkpointing, and optional tensor parallelism across a device mesh
get_device_mesh: create a CUDA device mesh with data parallel replicate, shard, and tensor parallel dimensions from distributed args
setup_torch_distributed: initialize torch distributed process group for single GPU, multi-GPU, multi-node, or SLURM jobs using NCCL backend
check_model_value_range: check a PyTorch model parameters for NaN, Inf, suspiciously large range or standard deviation, and all-zero values
dist_mean: compute the mean of a scalar value across all processes in a distributed device mesh using all_reduce
